朝活サイクリング

Giant Store Meguro-dori Saturday Morning Ride

Tokyo, Japan · Nakane, Meguro (Toritsu-daigaku station) · Road · Social

朝活サイクリング is a road and social group ride in Tokyo, Japan. It rolls every Saturday at 7:00 am local time from Giant Store Meguro-dori (ジャイアントストア目黒通り).

For visitors

No booking: just turn up. Any brand of bike is welcome, bought anywhere. Helmet and gloves asked for, and the store asks riders to carry bicycle insurance.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: set to the riders who show up; the Komazawa Park loop goes at beginner and cross-bike pace.
Check
Look at @giant_store_meguro the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the 朝活サイクリング group ride

A short Saturday-morning shop ride for new and easygoing riders: 20 to 30 km, back by about 9:00. The route is picked on the day from three standards: Tokyo Tower via Shiba Park, easy laps of Komazawa Park, or a photo stop at Giant Japan's head office. Beginners are the point of it.
